title: Walleye/Bows - Elbow - Sunday, July 14th | Channel 6-8
first_post_text: SKUNKED We fished 3.5 hours this morning with 6 rods/3 anglers using riggers, dipseys and boards. Beyond sheephead Albert lost one real big Rainbow that he hooked on a silver/blue NK28 35 feet down in 64 fow. A few anglers I talked to did better but not a whole lot. To be fair neither the Elbow nor the Lighthouse were ever a good bet following easterly winds. Even back in the days when limit catches were the norm we would often have to venture far out into much deeper water to get fish after an easterly. We stayed relatively close to the Elbow Gas Well marker this morning and never went much beyond 90 fow. We'll give the Elbow another chance later this season. People were getting fish but the fishery is far more predictable when we have prevailing winds. It was a nice day for a boat ride and all my lures are now clean.
